description_sq:
Toke per shitje ne Kashar.
Toka ka siperfaqe 1085m2 dhe ka leje ndertimi per dy vila dykateshe.
Ka dalje ne asfalt dhe eshte 200m larg rruges dytesore dhe autostrades Durres-Tirane.
Per me shume informacion apo nje vizite ne prone na kontaktoni!
description_en: Land for sale in Kashar. The land has an area of ​​1085m2 and has a building permit for two two-story villas. It has an asphalt exit and is 200m away from the secondary road and the Durres-Tirana highway. For more information or a visit to the property, contact us!
